dct_description_sm: The dataset contains temperature readings from a transect that runs the interior of a protected woodlot on the University of Guelph campus (the Dairy Bush) to near the middle of the field that is to the north of the woodlot (the Dairy Bush Field). Historically, the field has been cut in the late fall of each year; however during the period that this data was collected, the field was not cut. The dataset will be updated periodically as more data is accumulated.
dct_title_s: Temperature along an field-forest ecotone in Guelph Ontario: the Dairy Bush
